items/bonecage.notes: Bone Cage — attack weapon built on sicbo (dice family, grit). Three dice, a board of bets. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/bonetoss.notes: Bone Toss — attack weapon built on craps (dice family, grit). Come-out roll, then make your point. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/briefcase.notes: The Briefcase — spell weapon built on deal (picks family, greed). Keep a case, take the banker's offer or open yours. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/chainlightning.notes: Chain Lightning — attack weapon built on coinstreak (nerve family, nerve). Call the coin, ride the streak. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/clash.notes: Clash — versus weapon built on war (cards family, grit). High card wins. Ties go to Grit. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/coinblade.notes: Coin Blade — attack weapon built on fifty (wheels family, luck). Call it, then spin. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/diceduel.notes: Dice Duel — versus weapon built on hilodice (dice family, grit). Higher or lower on the dice, cash out before you bust. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/dragonsbreath.notes: Dragon's Breath — attack weapon built on dragontiger (cards family, greed). Dragon or Tiger — one card each. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/fusebomb.notes: Fuse Bomb — attack weapon built on crash (nerve family, nerve). Light the fuse, cash out before it blows. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/handoffate.notes: Hand of Fate — attack weapon built on videopoker (cards family, greed). Hold the cards you like, draw the rest. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/holdemduel.notes: Hold'em Duel — versus weapon built on holdem (cards family, greed). Hole cards, a flop, call or fold. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/houndsnap.notes: Hound Snap — attack weapon built on reddog (cards family, greed). Will the next card fall between the first two? Grid footprint 1x3.

items/jackpotcannon.notes: Jackpot Cannon — attack weapon built on slots (picks family, luck). Pull the lever, match the reels. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/letitride.notes: Let It Ride — attack weapon built on letitride (cards family, greed). Three bets riding — pull them back or let it ride. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/limborope.notes: Limbo Rope — attack weapon built on limbo (nerve family, nerve). Name a multiplier, see if the rope holds. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/loadeddice.notes: Loaded Dice — attack weapon built on dice (dice family, grit). Roll 1–100 against your own target. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/luckyseven.notes: Lucky Seven — attack weapon built on underover7 (dice family, grit). Two dice: under, over or exactly 7. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/mend.notes: Mend — spell weapon built on hilo (cards family, grit). Higher or lower, card after card. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/minefield.notes: Minefield — attack weapon built on mines (nerve family, nerve). Clear safe squares, walk away in time. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/pachinkohail.notes: Pachinko Hail — attack weapon built on pachinko (picks family, luck). Drop five balls, hope for the centre. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/prismspin.notes: Prism Spin — attack weapon built on colorwheel (wheels family, luck). Bet a colour, spin the prism. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/roadrun.notes: Road Run — attack weapon built on chicken (nerve family, nerve). Cross the road one lane at a time. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/rockslide.notes: Rockslide — attack weapon built on plinko (picks family, luck). Drop the rock, hope it bounces wide. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/roulettestorm.notes: Roulette Storm — area weapon built on roulette (wheels family, luck). Pick a bet, spin, cover the room. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/scratchcharm.notes: Scratch Charm — spell weapon built on scratch (picks family, luck). Scratch panels, match three. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/shellgame.notes: Shell Game — versus weapon built on thimbles (picks family, luck). Find the pea under one of three cups. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/siegetower.notes: Siege Tower — attack weapon built on tower (nerve family, nerve). Climb floor by floor, one door is safe. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/stampede.notes: Stampede — area weapon built on race (picks family, luck). Back a runner, watch the stampede. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/starshower.notes: Star Shower — attack weapon built on keno (picks family, luck). Pick your stars, the sky draws ten. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/thebus.notes: The Bus — attack weapon built on bus (cards family, nerve). Ride the bus: four calls in a row. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/trident.notes: Trident — attack weapon built on threecard (cards family, greed). Three cards: play or fold. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/tripledice.notes: Triple Dice — attack weapon built on chuckaluck (dice family, grit). Pick a number, three dice roll. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/twinfang.notes: Twin Fang — attack weapon built on baccarat (cards family, greed). Player, Banker or Tie — then watch. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/twinward.notes: Twin Ward — spell weapon built on paigow (cards family, grit). Split seven cards into a high hand and a low hand. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/ward.notes: Ward — spell weapon built on blackjack (cards family, greed). Beat the dealer without going over 21. Grid footprint 1x3.

items/wheelofruin.notes: Wheel of Ruin — attack weapon built on bigwheel (wheels family, luck). One spin, seven segments. Grid footprint 1x3.

monsters/ash_croupier.notes: Ash Croupier — common of caldera region. What is left of a dealer after the furnace door opened on them. Holds its shape by habit alone. (1024 px portrait with alpha)

monsters/ash_croupier_token.notes: Ash Croupier — common of caldera region. What is left of a dealer after the furnace door opened on them. Holds its shape by habit alone. (256 px head token for the hex)

monsters/blackwood_owl.notes: Blackwood Owl — common of blackwood region. Watches every hand in the forest and remembers all of them. Its eyes are two face-down cards. (1024 px portrait with alpha)

monsters/blackwood_owl_token.notes: Blackwood Owl — common of blackwood region. Watches every hand in the forest and remembers all of them. Its eyes are two face-down cards. (256 px head token for the hex)

monsters/boss_strip.notes: Lady Neon, the Last Lit Sign — boss of strip region. The one sign still burning on the Strip, and the thing that lives inside it. She has watched every run begin. (1024 px portrait with alpha)

monsters/boss_strip_token.notes: Lady Neon, the Last Lit Sign — boss of strip region. The one sign still burning on the Strip, and the thing that lives inside it. She has watched every run begin. (256 px head token for the hex)

monsters/card_shark.notes: Card Shark — common of strip region. A literal shark in a waistcoat. It has never lost a hand it dealt itself and does not intend to start with yours. (1024 px portrait with alpha)

monsters/card_shark_token.notes: Card Shark — common of strip region. A literal shark in a waistcoat. It has never lost a hand it dealt itself and does not intend to start with yours. (256 px head token for the hex)

monsters/cloud_usher.notes: Cloud Usher — common of citadel region. Shows you to your seat. The seat is the edge of the tower and the view is the drop. (1024 px portrait with alpha)

monsters/cloud_usher_token.notes: Cloud Usher — common of citadel region. Shows you to your seat. The seat is the edge of the tower and the view is the drop. (256 px head token for the hex)

monsters/drowned_dealer.notes: Drowned Dealer — common of docks region. Went into the black water with the night's take and came back without it. It wants a word about the shortfall. (1024 px portrait with alpha)

monsters/drowned_dealer_token.notes: Drowned Dealer — common of docks region. Went into the black water with the night's take and came back without it. It wants a word about the shortfall. (256 px head token for the hex)

monsters/drunk_revenant.notes: Drunk Croupier Revenant — common of strip region. Still dealing. Still drinking. Still dead. The first thing every run meets, swaying under the one lit sign. (1024 px portrait with alpha)

monsters/drunk_revenant_token.notes: Drunk Croupier Revenant — common of strip region. Still dealing. Still drinking. Still dead. The first thing every run meets, swaying under the one lit sign. (256 px head token for the hex)

monsters/fog_lamplighter.notes: Fog Lamplighter — common of docks region. Lights the lanterns that lead you off the pier. The fog is its, and so is everyone in it. (1024 px portrait with alpha)

monsters/fog_lamplighter_token.notes: Fog Lamplighter — common of docks region. Lights the lanterns that lead you off the pier. The fog is its, and so is everyone in it. (256 px head token for the hex)

monsters/hanged_dice_wraith.notes: Hanged-Dice Wraith — common of blackwood region. The knucklebones on the ropes are its teeth. It rattles them when the wind is right and when it is not. (1024 px portrait with alpha)

monsters/hanged_dice_wraith_token.notes: Hanged-Dice Wraith — common of blackwood region. The knucklebones on the ropes are its teeth. It rattles them when the wind is right and when it is not. (256 px head token for the hex)

monsters/molten_chip_golem.notes: Molten Chip Golem — common of caldera region. A stack of chips that never cooled. Every one of them was somebody's last. (1024 px portrait with alpha)

monsters/molten_chip_golem_token.notes: Molten Chip Golem — common of caldera region. A stack of chips that never cooled. Every one of them was somebody's last. (256 px head token for the hex)

monsters/roulette_wraith.notes: Roulette Wraith — common of strip region. A breaking wheel with a face in the hub. It spins when it screams and it screams when it spins. (1024 px portrait with alpha)

monsters/roulette_wraith_token.notes: Roulette Wraith — common of strip region. A breaking wheel with a face in the hub. It spins when it screams and it screams when it spins. (256 px head token for the hex)

tiles/arena.notes: Hex tile glyph: arena glyph — Challenge a player to a Challenge Wheel fight or a pet battle with a Gold wager and a crowd bonus.

tiles/blocker.notes: Hex tile glyph: blocker glyph — A destructible heap that blocks the hex and drops Gold when broken.

tiles/bloodbank.notes: Hex tile glyph: bloodbank glyph — Take or repay a Blood Pact.

tiles/bossgate.notes: Hex tile glyph: bossgate glyph — Fight the region boss if level or key allows, else bounce back three tiles.

tiles/bounty.notes: Hex tile glyph: bounty glyph — Place or claim a bounty; take a public quest.

tiles/chaos.notes: Hex tile glyph: chaos glyph — Spin the Chaos Wheel; tiers escalate as the run goes on.

tiles/chest.notes: Hex tile glyph: chest glyph — Spin the Loot Wheel for an item (rarity by region), Gold or an egg.

tiles/courier.notes: Hex tile glyph: courier glyph — The crow's roost. Letters in transit pass through here; whoever stands on it reads them first.

tiles/encounter.notes: Hex tile glyph: encounter glyph — A monster from the region's table appears with its own Health and two moves. Fight it with your items; it drops Gold, an item or an egg when it dies.

tiles/event.notes: Hex tile glyph: event glyph — Spin the Fate Wheel.

tiles/graveyard.notes: Hex tile glyph: graveyard glyph — Dead players wake here after their missed turns; what they dropped stays where they fell.

tiles/shop.notes: Hex tile glyph: shop glyph — Buy items, potions and trinkets with Gold; sell back at half price.

tiles/start.notes: Hex tile glyph: start glyph — Where the run begins, under the one sign still lit. A safe tile.

tiles/throne.notes: Hex tile glyph: throne glyph — The Dealer's chair. Sit on it once the Dealer is dead and the run is won.

wheels/chaos.notes: Chaos Wheel face — 11 segments: The Collector, Blood in the Water, Marked Class, Shuffle the Cage, Mercy, Scapegoat, Tighten the Bars, Sticky Fingers, Escalation, Scatter, Apocalypse. Slices must stay equal-weight friendly: the renderer draws weighted wedges itself; a painted face is only used when the odds are equal.

wheels/hub.notes: wheels/hub face — 0 segments: . Slices must stay equal-weight friendly: the renderer draws weighted wedges itself; a painted face is only used when the odds are equal.

wheels/loot.notes: Loot Wheel face — 3 segments: Item, Gold, Egg. Slices must stay equal-weight friendly: the renderer draws weighted wedges itself; a painted face is only used when the odds are equal.

wheels/movement.notes: Movement Wheel face — 10 segments: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, Sprint, Stumble, Teleport, Swap. Slices must stay equal-weight friendly: the renderer draws weighted wedges itself; a painted face is only used when the odds are equal.

wheels/pointer.notes: wheels/pointer face — 0 segments: . Slices must stay equal-weight friendly: the renderer draws weighted wedges itself; a painted face is only used when the odds are equal.

legendary/amuletofpotency.notes: Amulet of Potency (Legendary necklace, nods to Old School RuneScape): +6% damage on every hit and +1 to all four stats. The plainest Legendary and the one everyone wants. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/bigfancygun.notes: Big Fancy Gun (Legendary weapon, nods to Doom): Stake 50; hits every player and monster on your hex and all six neighbours. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/blockbreaker.notes: Blockbreaker Pick (Legendary offhand, nods to Minecraft): Walk through one void hex per turn; it is dug and stays open for everyone. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/broadside.notes: Corvette Broadside (Legendary weapon, nods to Elite Dangerous): Fires a line: every player and monster in 3 hexes straight ahead takes the hit. Stake 50; so heavy you move 1 hex less while it is wielded. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/bustercleaver.notes: Oversized Buster Cleaver (Legendary weapon, nods to Final Fantasy VII): Stake 50, +50% damage, swings last in the turn because of the weight. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/cameraobscura.notes: Camera Obscura (Legendary offhand, nods to Fatal Frame): Three shots per run. A photo of a player reveals their exact Health and worn items to you; a photo of a revenant or wraith deals 15 and pins it for a turn. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/carapace.notes: Spiny Blue Carapace (Legendary consumable, nods to Mario Kart DS): Throw it: the player currently leading on score takes 30 wherever they are. Cannot be dodged; a Fork can split it. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/chickendinner.notes: Chicken Dinner Platter (Legendary consumable, nods to PUBG): Only usable by the last player standing in Royale: heals to full and vaults an extra item. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/croupierscoat.notes: The Croupier's Coat (Legendary torso, nods to The affix table's own example): Opponents must stake at least 20 against you. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/deepseasuit.notes: Deep-Sea Suit (Legendary torso, nods to Animal Crossing: New Leaf): Water void hexes are passable for you; once per run you surface from one with a random Rare item. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/emberflask.notes: Ember Flask (Legendary consumable, nods to Dark Souls): Heals 30; refills to 3 charges at every Inn. Resting resets the region's monsters. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/fairyjar.notes: Fairy in a Jar (Legendary consumable, nods to Zelda): Sits in the grid. When you would die the jar breaks and you stand back up at 50% on the spot, no turns missed, no drops. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/gravitygauntlet.notes: Gravity Gauntlet (Legendary gloves, nods to Half-Life): Once per run, pull any player within 3 hexes onto your hex. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/impostorsvisor.notes: Impostor's Visor (Legendary helmet, nods to Among Us): Your letters cannot be intercepted, and for 2 turns the TV shows you as another player's sprite. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/infernalmantle.notes: Infernal Mantle (Legendary cape, nods to Old School RuneScape): Never dropped: awarded for clearing the deepest tier without dying. +3 Grit, immune to the Caldera's damage doubling, and the sprite burns. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/ocarina.notes: Clay Ocarina (Legendary spell, nods to Zelda): Three songs, each once per run: return to the last Inn you visited; skip the next Chaos turn; call a fainted pet back at 1 Power. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/octanetreads.notes: Octane Treads (Legendary boots, nods to Rocket League): The movement wheel loses Stumble and gains two Boost 8 segments; ending your move next to a player bumps them 1 hex. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/pedestalblade.notes: Pedestal Blade (Legendary weapon, nods to Zelda): Cannot be drawn under level 10. At full Health, reach 3 instead of 1. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/pendant.notes: Weighted Companion Pendant (Legendary necklace, nods to Portal): When you would die, the pendant is destroyed instead and you stay at 1 Health. It never says goodbye. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/pipbuoy.notes: Pip-Buoy (Legendary ring, nods to Fallout): Shows the exact Health of every player within 2 hexes, breaking the thirds tell. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/poolladder.notes: Pool Ladder (Legendary offhand, nods to The Sims): Place it on any hex to make it a pool; take the ladder away and whoever is in the pool cannot leave for 2 turns and loses 5 Health a turn. Put it back to let them out. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/raillance.notes: Rail Lance (Legendary weapon, nods to Killing Floor 2): Lock on: name a target within 3 hexes; the next hit cannot miss (a loss becomes a push). Stake 35, one lock per fight. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/resetcartridge.notes: Reset Cartridge (Legendary consumable, nods to The Sims (resetsim)): Resets your character to a clean state: clears every curse, pool, Blood Pact interest and Chaos effect on you and stands you on the last safe hex you visited. Also a GM console command for a stuck player. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/skatesofthesixth.notes: Skates of the Sixth (Legendary boots, nods to Pokemon X and Y): Roll 2d6, but you cannot stop early and you slide one extra hex in your last direction. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/tamersnare.notes: Tamer's Snare (Legendary consumable, nods to Pokemon): Throw at a monster under 25% Health to catch it as a pet instead of killing it. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/thejoker.notes: The Joker (Legendary weapon, nods to Balatro): Jokers count wild in your Video Poker hand; a five-of-a-kind is a double crit. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/theshout.notes: The Shout (Legendary spell, nods to Skyrim): Push every adjacent player and monster 2 hexes away; stake 20. — worn layer, 5 poses

legendary/toadstool.notes: Green-Cap Toadstool (Legendary consumable, nods to Mario): Eat it to bank an extra life: your next death costs no items and no turns. — worn layer, 5 poses
